discussion.body: Act 2 storyboard. Locations: dwarf-rail, Constium forges, Temple of Earth, Cannon mouth tour. Join: Brann (FEAT-030). Beats: rail-in against alpine green; shop-floor accident Brann will not call an accident; Earth dungeon and Keystone Sigil; Vortan hosts the party and is kind; the barrel geometry points at Temple of Fire, not at the Orc Invasion. Death crisis: Brann can die in the shop-floor event if the party ignores his warning to cut the pressure line. Default live. Contingency: his gauging book still explains the barrel aim. Variation: none that changes later acts except Brann absent. Frames: rail, forge floor, earth sanctum, Cannon lip, Vortan hall.
